in.other_title: Find a common state with independently bounded mismatch
in.rationale: A literal disjoint-tag embedding is proved vacuous; the shared-abstraction problem remains open.

rules: Every record and link keeps its recorded state; most are PROPOSED (AI-drafted, unreviewed). Say so when you use them.

Cite the paper and the PDF page in the record's sources, and check the paper before relying on a claim.

state_meaning: A machine check (for example a Lean proof check) passed for the stated scope only; meaning is not reviewed.
text: For the particular disjoint-tag state encoding, Lean proves first-stage mismatch mass exactly one under every normalized finite coupling, even when the formal stage terminates. Any nonnegative transfer budget then cannot beat a threshold at or below one. This does not rule out another shared abstraction or theorem.
title: Literal formal-history versus text-transcript tagging is vacuous
